title: North of 60
description: Peter suspects Albert may have underhandedly persuaded Betty Moses to choose Lynx River as the site of her new treatment center.

title: APTN National News
description: Bringing news stories that matter to Indigenous Peoples.

title: APTN Investigates
description: For more than a century, Winnipeg has drawn its drinking water from Shoal Lake; now, Shoal Lake 39 First Nation is suing the city and Ontario for $2 billion, alleging their home and way of life have paid the price; Christopher Read investigates.

title: Chums
description: The snow begins to melt. Romper helps two ground squirrels whose burrow is flooded, but living together isn't easy.

title: Lil' Glooscap and the Legend of Turtle Island
description: Lil Glooscap and friends learn that they all want to be good at things, but practice and patience are key to achieving their goals; only with repetition and determination can they improve their skills.

title: Indigenous Art Adventures
description: Follow along with Lance Cardinal to craft your own yarn-braided sweetgrass. Learn the Cree word of the day, wîhkwaskwa, meaning sweetgrass. Sweetgrass is picked from Mother Earth and traditionally braided by two people into three groups of seven blades.

title: Anaana's Tent
description: Rita Claire learns about skills that mothers traditionally teach to their children, including sewing, beading, and preparing seal skins; Evie Arnaquq sings Nukakulu.

title: Ukaliq and Kalla
description: Kalla shares her egg-picking expertise with Ukaliq; she visits Ukaliq's messy home and together, they team up to tidy the house!

title: Dreamcatchers
description: A group of Indigenous teens use their ancestral super powers to battle evil in the form of large corporations threatening the environment and their traditional way of life.

title: Le petit Glooscap et les légendes de l'île de la Tortue
description: P'tit Glooscap et ses amis apprennent qu'ils sont chanceux d'avoir tout ce qu'ils ont ; ils doivent prendre soin de tous leurs amis et leurs biens s'ils veulent les garder.

title: Savoirs légendaires
description: À travers des récits légendaires, on va à la rencontre des jeunes pour transmettre des savoirs, des valeurs et des leçons de vie tout en perpétuant la tradition de la transmission orale.

title: La brigade
description: Sara veut choisir le film de la soirée cinéma à la place de madame Labossière, qui sélectionne des films trop enfantins.

title: Nations des animaux
description: Un voyage à travers le Canada révèle comment les castors façonnent les écosystèmes, restaurent les zones humides et relient les communautés autochtones à la terre. D'un océan à l'autre, les castors sont des symboles de renouveau et de résilience.

title: Little Big Community
description: The Oneida Nation of the Thames has long lived with the scars of colonialism but is now turning to traditional practices to heal; meeting Dayna and Ron, two Oneida siblings dedicated to educating youth and strengthening their community.

title: Animal Nation
description: Indigenous communities in British Columbia and Labrador restore salmon populations and revitalize cultural traditions by monitoring, rearing and releasing young salmon in the spring.

title: Frozen Planet II
description: Found on every continent, mountains create unique frozen worlds, home to extraordinary animals that must overcome the crushing conditions of the cold.

title: Meadowlarks
description: Four siblings, torn apart by the Sixties Scoop, reunite for one week.

title: Meadowlarks

title: Best in Miniature
description: It's an explosion of color as the six remaining miniaturists are paired up to share their artistic visions in the mini challenge and then are set free to build a room of their choice.

title: APTN Investigates
description: A look into complex issues.

title: Live: NHL Hockey
description: From PPG Paints Arena in Pittsburgh.

title: Missing From Fire Trail Road
description: A documentary detailing the case of Mary Ellen Johnson-Davis, a Native American woman who disappeared in 2020. Her story exposes how hundreds of indigenous women continue to go missing in the USA, perpetuating trans-generational traumas.

title: Mohawk Girls
description: Caitlin fears she'll lose Butterhead; Zoe stands up to her parents for the first time; Bailey wavers on her decision.

title: Mohawk Girls
description: Bailey wants both James and a place in her community; Anna finally takes a stand; Zoe considers a life change.

title: Missing From Fire Trail Road
description: A documentary detailing the case of Mary Ellen Johnson-Davis, a Native American woman who disappeared in 2020. Her story exposes how hundreds of indigenous women continue to go missing in the USA, perpetuating trans-generational traumas.

title: North of North
description: Six weeks later as Spring continues to thaw the Arctic, the community comes together to challenge Ice Cove's rivals to a not-so-friendly game of northern baseball.

title: Coastal Carvings
description: Tensions are high during final preparations for the Coastal Carvings showcase event where clients, family and friends gather to enjoy and celebrate the gallery and special pieces on display.

title: Chuck and the First Peoples' Kitchen
description: Chuck visits Kahnawà:ke to learn about corn; it is harvest day and members of the community have gathered to collect some corn and make a traditional soup.

title: Wild Rose Vets
description: Dr. Cori sees Trooper the dog over several days to figure out why he won't eat and each day the stakes get higher; after a tricky eye surgery on Ben the dog, Dr. Allison heads to the bush with her mom for a dog sledding adventure.

title: APTN Investigates
description: A look into complex issues.

title: Nunami Piqatigiit: Tundra Friends
description: Uka feels sad and upset when Sissi forgets about their play date, so Uka talks to Miki about his feelings; Tuka gets worried when Sissi is grumpy and rude, but their teacher helps them talk through the problem together.

title: Tuktu
description: An educational preschool children's series, featuring five Arctic animal friends.

title: Chums
description: A young girl and her furry friends travel across Turtle Island and embark on adventures that help them navigate their connections with each other, other animals and the environment.

title: The Magic Canoe
description: When Julie gets stuck in the pond, she is too embarrassed and proud to ask for help; she learns that everyone needs help sometimes and that it's okay to ask for it!

title: Indigenous Art Adventures
description: Lance Cardinal teaches how to make beautiful Métis felt flowers; the Métis are well-known for their floral beadwork; Lance teaches the Cree word of the day, wâpakwanîs, which means flower.

title: Coyote's Crazy Smart Science Show
description: Computers have their own languages that they use to communicate with each other; Michael and Caroline Running Wolf teach the Science Questers about the connection between computer programming and Indigenous knowledge.

title: Le petit Glooscap et les légendes de l'île de la Tortue
description: P'tit Glooscap et ses amis apprennent qu'ils sont chanceux d'avoir tout ce qu'ils ont ; ils doivent prendre soin de tous leurs amis et leurs biens s'ils veulent les garder.

title: La brigade
description: Sara veut utiliser le dernier cours du vendredi pour souligner la Journée de la vérité et de la réconciliation, mais Laboss impose ses conditions. Éric s'imagine que Stéphanie a le béguin pour lui.

title: Capteurs de rêves
description: Lorsque les Capteurs de rêves saisissent un rêve dans lequel une centrale hydroélectrique inonde une réserve locale, ils doivent trouver la Rêveuse, débloquer ses superpouvoirs ancestraux et empêcher le rêve de se réaliser.

title: Kiuna, plus qu'une école
description: C'est la rentrée scolaire et les étudiant.e.s sillonnent les corridors de Kiuna, le seul collège autochtone au Québec, avec la directrice Prudence.

title: Red River Gold
description: The team returns to the Brokenhead River, where stories have long swirled about hidden gold. Finding one treasure with teeth and one that's for teeth, they feel success is inevitable.

title: Water Worlds
description: Pacific herring are integral to the West Coast food web but overfishing and habitat loss have endangered their populations; conservationists are raising awareness and working on solutions to protect this keystone species.

title: The Nature of Things
description: New archaeological discoveries are challenging the understanding of when the first people arrived in North America, rewriting the human story.

title: Life Below Zero
description: Early melting ice forces inhabitants to move their camp out of danger; the residents teach critical survival skills, stockpile resources and brave the uncertain tundra to transport a key piece of equipment.

title: Racing Waters
description: The Island Brave paddlers begin their journey at the CORA Cup Race, Island Iron Comox, where they must complete a qualifying race to be eligible for Brazil; back at Musqueam, fierce rivals remind the team that every opportunity must be earned.

title: Northern Air Rescue
description: As the forest fire crisis worsens, new Missinippi pilots learn to fly through heat and smoke to keep the community supplied; when another First Nation receives an evacuation order, Missinippi mounts an emergency rescue mission to fly evacuees to Winnipeg.

title: Missing From Fire Trail Road
description: A documentary detailing the case of Mary Ellen Johnson-Davis, a Native American woman who disappeared in 2020. Her story exposes how hundreds of indigenous women continue to go missing in the USA, perpetuating trans-generational traumas.

title: Ghost Hunters of the Grand River
description: Murney Tower Redoubt, built in 1846, where history meets the paranormal; from eerie poltergeist activity to spectral soldiers, every stone wall hides a chilling secret.

title: Northwoods Survival
description: It's a return to a life free from the reliance on modern conveniences and away from the hustle and pollution of cities; it's a gamble that comes with a glorious upside, but also frighteningly high stakes.

title: APTN Investigates: A Retrospective
description: Holly speaks with survivors of Indian hospitals and tuberculosis sanatoriums, who share their stories of starvation, culture loss and experimentation.

title: Life Below Zero
description: The northern residents handle the melting tundra as they gather a new food source, take advantage of flowing water to hunt geese and prepare for the breakup of river ice.

title: Racing Waters
description: Island Brave heads to the Lummi Stommish Festival, where fierce rivals and Team Canada selection pressure test the crew. After falling short, they discover that growth comes from confronting weaknesses and trusting one another.
